name: poly_x4_sub_10x2_add_1_irreducible_int
informal: The minimal polynomial X^4 - 10X^2 + 1 of √2+√3 is irreducible over ℤ — no integer roots (±1 fail); a factorisation into monic quadratics (X^2+aX+b)(X^2-aX+d) with bd = 1 forces a(d-b) = 0 and b+d-a^2 = -10, i.e. a^2 = 12 or a^2 = 8 or (a = 0, b + d = -10 with bd = 1), all impossible.
